name: Artwork Fixer
description: Artwork Fixer adds an admin-only page to the Jellyfin dashboard. It scans your movies and shows and lists those with no poster, no backdrop (and, if you choose, no logo), or with a poster or backdrop that is smaller than the size you set. Select a title to see the alternative images your metadata sources offer, sorted by your preferred language, rating and size, and apply one with a single click. You can also upload your own image or refresh a title's metadata. Only administrators can open the page or change images.
overview: Finds movies and shows with missing or low-quality artwork and lets you replace it from one admin-only page.
